message: The other day, I decided to finally tackle our family go-bags. I mean, it only took me three years! So, there I was, digging through the closet, uncovering a treasure trove of old toys and half-broken crayons. I laughed when I found a pack of expired snacks and a mismatched sock that I swear belonged to my dog. 🤷‍♀️ It was a good reminder that it’s not about being perfectly prepared; it’s about taking small steps. I feel a little better knowing I’ve started, even if my go-bags still need work. What’s your favorite trick for getting organized?
